body:
FORMAL BLOCK — P1R external runtime admission handoff

Reviewed object: /private/tmp/storymodel4s-amr-runtime.EkToyR/runtime-handoff.json, SHA-256 6dd741f67731b478052ca3481115f86ebb42d5e9d2b7ef39f94f36bab7ded76e. Read-only review under msg-01M1CXH8D518DHRGV2V4W4Y620. No repository paths, new downloads, credentials, terms, remote text, or participant text.

Positive evidence retained:

- shasum -a 256 reverified requirements.freeze.txt = 8557f7a3b8ae8c240e31f8e10954df30d26d8fa4bc7283a19f5a039ac8e7cae8; uv pip freeze --python <root>/venv/bin/python exactly matched all 61 recorded packages.
- Reverified Python = 1110a74ed5e281d9d89b0e0bf0b5be5e36e4b3301f424cfa8ec4f8eae8ec6295; model archive = ecaa2d9b6b17d6a86af54a784e9ed1dd1c879a23f79918aa68b53b4a3766cc26; model files = a98211d5..., fbe80544..., b753fffa..., 281b14c5...; tokenizer files = c4022c93..., 1ce16647..., 847bbeab..., 9e7f63c2...; qualification script = a7fd8c12381aac7fd597af056412664b181126f9eaa32401d6880ea5eb544082; receipt files = c3f9a428... and fe50e22f.... Every value matched the handoff.
- jq -s confirmed identical ordered 50-outcome arrays, 50 checked-success on each run, and no missing outcome. jq -cS '.outcomes' plus its newline recomputed aa65f874455d5517c0edcbad5f7849be8ce2f42685a9d900801a65a9d4244567 exactly.
- Official refs verified without checkout: git ls-remote --tags returned amrlib refs/tags/0.8.1 = 38b29706ea982da5a5b081a04f00c93cc6cc1e9c and amrlib-models refs/tags/parse_xfm_bart_base-v0_1_0 = 7aa7a5bf3bb8f0e02ace0c95cc0b85edefd98c53. git ls-remote https://huggingface.co/facebook/bart-base returned HEAD/main = aadd2ab0ae0c8268c7c9693540e9904811f36177. Primary repository/model pages support MIT, MIT, and Apache-2.0 respectively.
- With HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, a local-path-only generic sentence smoke loaded the pinned model/tokenizer and produced checked PENMAN with a top and five triples.
- git ls-files and git status searches found no amrlib/BART/model binary; the largest HEAD blob was 257426 bytes, and an all-ref object scan found no blob over 10 MB. Runtime/model files are external.

Blocking findings:

1. Missing explicit dependency licence. runtime-handoff.json:28-35 adds Unidecode 1.4.0 and its wheel digest but no licence or licence-source digest. The installed primary wheel metadata states GPL and GPLv2+; installed licence SHA-256 is 8177f97513213526df2cf6184d8ff986c675afb514d4e68a404010521b880643. This does not say GPL prevents local use; it says the required component/licence record is incomplete.

2. The 50 inputs are not joined to the repository fixture identity. qualify_runtime.py:20-23 reads a mutable source path; :123-139 independently reimplements splitting and asserts only len(sentences) == 50. runtime-handoff.json has no StorySource checksum, SurfaceAtlas/analyzer identity, or ordered canonical sentence-set identity. Substituting a different 50-sentence input can still produce a nominal 50/50 receipt. Bind the admitted source checksum and ordered sentence digest vector derived from the checked repository SurfaceAtlas, plus analyzer/code identity, and refuse foreign source or segmentation.

3. The handoff is not self-contained as an identity join. runtime-handoff.json:76 names requirements.freeze.txt but omits its digest; the digest exists only in a separate message. The original amrlib and Unidecode wheel bytes are absent from the handoff directory, so their claimed wheel hashes cannot be independently reverified from this object. The two receipt hashes omit filenames. Embed the freeze digest, explicit receipt paths, and resolvable external asset identities/locations; binaries may remain outside Git.

4. PinnedRuntime configuration is only implicit in qualify_runtime.py literals. The handoff has no checked configuration object/digest for device, batch_size, num_beams, local tokenizer selection, add_metadata, disable_progress, or deterministic execution policy. Bind and derive that configuration explicitly; a script checksum is provenance for code, not a typed runtime configuration identity.

Scientific limit: the observed 50/50 result establishes syntactic PENMAN decodability and same-environment replay for this unjoined 50-unit extraction. It does not establish semantic accuracy, canonical PropositionChart conversion, held-out validity, transcript performance, NarrativeCompilation, or recall alignment. The handoff itself states most of this limit correctly.

Verdict: BLOCK external runtime admission and any PinnedRuntime/50-of-50 completion claim until findings 1-4 are repaired and reverified. This does not reject amrlib, the pinned model, or continued author work.
